comments.value: Agreed, I am a vive player but all my friends are on occulus. I am also the game master/party leader that sets up the worlds we’re going to play together. This would be helpful
I host events that are meant to be Quest-compatible. I'm a desktop VR user without a Quest so having this option would help a lot with planning!
Yes, please add cross-platform filtering to 2.0 menu

details:
When I play with friends using Oculus Quest and want to guide them around various worlds, I always struggle to find world compatible for them, because tons of PC-Only worlds are hit in world search result. If there were a way to search Cross-Platform Worlds easily, it should be a nice QOL improvement feature!
JP:
Questの友達と遊んでるときに、対応しているワールドを探すのに苦労するので、クロスプラットフォーム対応ワールドのみ検索にヒットする設定が欲しいです。
title: Add "Cross-Platform Worlds Only" Search Option.
